key.name: configuration
key.summary: WaylandShader monitor profiles and preset settings
key.description: Versioned native-backend JSON. Independent of the KWin configuration; updated by the WaylandShader GNOME controller.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON object mapping each profile name to its preset, that preset's parameter overrides, and monitor settings.

key.name: default-profile
key.description: Name of the profile applied over the saved configuration when the extension starts; empty restores the last session.
